svg.title: D-FINE-S + AQS
svg.desc: Publication-style architecture of the actual SCB-S D-FINE-S AQS-L2 model. Tensor pyramids and encoder partitions follow HF-D-FINE-style presentation, and token columns/decoder heads follow DETRPose-style presentation. Reference-paper modules are not transplanted.

g.text: Overall architecture of D-FINE-S with Adaptive Query Selection (AQS)
HGNetV2-B0 / original Hybrid Encoder / AQS after Decoder Layer 2 / original FDR heads
Added AQS: query enhancement, not query pruning
FPN / PAN, initial boxes, FDR and original losses are retained.
L2 FDR is computed before AQS; updated queries then reach L3.
Feature maps and token columns are schematic; no performance values are illustrated.
Inference structure of the SCB-S three-class model. DN and training-only auxiliary supervision are omitted.
